Deadly Aspects.t: Aspects add a chance for bonus attack speed
Deadly Aspects.sig: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a #% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by #% for # sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a #% chance of increasing melee attack speed by #% for # sec.

Endurance Training.sig: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by #%.

Focused Fire.t: +{1}% damage for you and your pet
Focused Fire.sig: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by #% while your pet is active.

Improved Aspect of the Monkey.t: Aspect of the Monkey +{1}% dodge, half for your pet
Improved Aspect of the Monkey.sig: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by #%. Additionally, your pet gains #% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

Improved Revive Pet.sig: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by # sec, mana cost is reduced by #%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional #%.

Pathfinding.sig: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by #%.

Bestial Swiftness.sig: Increases the movement speed of your pets by #%.

Unleashed Fury.sig: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by #%.

Improved Mend Pet.sig: Gives your Mend Pet spell a #% chance of cleansing # Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by #%.

Ferocity.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by #%.

Summon Hawk.t: A hawk dive-bombs your target for {3} sec
Summon Hawk.sig: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing # plus #% of your Ranged Attack Power Physical damage and continuing its assault for # sec. Only # hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Spirit Bond.t: You and your pet regen {1}% health every {2} sec
Spirit Bond.sig: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate #% of total health every # sec.

Intimidation.t: Pet stuns the target for {1} sec
Intimidation.sig: Command your pet to Stun the target for # sec on its next successful attack, which also gains #% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

Bestial Discipline.t: Pet focus regen +{1}%, {2}% mana regen while casting
Bestial Discipline.sig: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by #% and allows #% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Frenzy.t: Pet crits give +{2}% attack speed for {3} sec
Frenzy.sig: Gives your pet a #% chance to gain a #% attack speed increase for # sec after dealing a critical strike.

Bestial Wrath.t: Pet deals {1}% more damage for {2} sec and can't be stopped
Bestial Wrath.sig: Send your pet into a rage causing #% additional damage for # sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

Hawk Eye.sig: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by # yards.

Improved Concussive Shot.t: {1}% chance Concussive Shot stuns for {2} sec
Improved Concussive Shot.sig: Gives your Concussive Shot a #% chance to stun the target for # sec.

Lethal Attacks.sig: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by #%.

Improved Stings.t: Serpent Sting +{1}%, Viper Sting cooldown {2} sec shorter
Improved Stings.sig: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by #%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by # sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by # sec.

Efficiency.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by #%.

Careful Aim.sig: Increases your Attack Power by #% of your Intellect.

Rapid Killing.t: Rapid Fire cooldown {1} min shorter, kills boost your next shot
Rapid Killing.sig: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by # min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within # sec by #%.

Improved Arcane Shot.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by # sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Lone Wolf.sig: You deal #% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

Trueshot Aura.sig: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within # yds by #.

Mortal Shots.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by #%.

Rapid Recuperation.t: Serpent Sting lets {1}% mana regen continue while casting
Rapid Recuperation.sig: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows #% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for # sec, increased to #% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

Barrage.sig: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by #%.

Scatter Shot.t: Short-range shot that disorients for {2} sec
Scatter Shot.sig: A short-range shot that deals #% weapon damage and disorients the target for # sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

Ranged Weapon Specialization.sig: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by #%.

Sniper Shot.t: Long-range shot, next {2} shots reach {3} yards farther
Sniper Shot.sig: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus # and increases the range of your next # Shots by # yards for # sec.

Improved Tracking.t: +{1}% damage to the tracked creature type
Improved Tracking.sig: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by #%.

Entrapment.t: Traps root everything they catch for {1} sec
Entrapment.sig: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for # sec.

Savage Strikes.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by #%.

Improved Wing Clip.t: {1}% chance Wing Clip roots for {2} sec
Improved Wing Clip.sig: Gives your Wing Clip ability a #% chance to immobilize the target for # sec.

Clever Traps.t: Freezing and Frost traps last {1}% longer, fire traps {2}% stronger
Clever Traps.sig: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by #% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by #%.

Surefooted.sig: Increases your hit chance by #% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by #%.

Deterrence.sig: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by #% for # sec.

Survival Tactics.t: Traps and Feign Death {1}% more reliable
Survival Tactics.sig: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by #%.

Predator's Edge.sig: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by #% and your Off Hand weapon damage by #%.

Counterattack.t: After a parry: hit and root for {3} sec
Counterattack.sig: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals #% weapon damage plus # and immobilizes the target for # sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Resourcefulness.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by #%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a #% chance to allow #% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for # sec.

Expose Prey.t: {1}% chance for Mongoose Bite on marked targets
Expose Prey.sig: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a #% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts # sec.

Survivalist's Discipline.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by #%.

Strider Kick.sig: A powerful kick that deals #% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by #% for # sec.

Lacerating Strikes.t: Mongoose Bite bleeds for {1}% more over {2} sec
Lacerating Strikes.sig: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to #% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over # sec

_spells.Hunter's Mark: More ranged attack power against the target

_spells.Aimed Shot: Big shot, trainable at 20 in Forever
_spells.Deterrence: More dodge and parry for 10 sec
_spells.Counterattack: Melee counter after a parry, roots
_spells.Strider Kick: Melee kick and a speed boost
_spells.Aspect of the Pack: Group run speed, dazed when hit
_spells.Tranquilizing Shot: Removes an enrage from a beast
